protocol.oracle: Block any Patch containing a labeled anomalous valid point as key/value at every layer; retain all queries
protocol.random: Uniform subset of valid Patches with exactly the same retained count in each window; 5 fixed seeds
protocol.empty_reference: Baseline fallback in every arm; separately report metrics on matched eligible points
protocol.real_normalization: Official full-series mean and std, unchanged between arms
protocol.synthetic_normalization: Clean generator mean/std fixed across all anomaly counts; not official per-corrupted-series normalization
protocol.scope: Development mechanism diagnostic, labels used by oracle only; no deployment claim
